summary: Give the scoped-tick write-scope decision one home; the renderer, the write guard and the agreement case read it there instead of each restating it

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests: the shared entry write scope is the assigned entry's declared files union the phase's channel paths when scopeWritesToEntry is declared
the shared entry write scope is absent when the phase omits scopeWritesToEntry, and when no entry is assigned
pins: the rendered effective fence names exactly the paths the write guard accepts for the same phase and entry
acceptance: One derivation of scoped-or-not plus its two inputs; no site restates declaredPaths(entry) union entryChannelPaths beside it, and the agreement case no longer hand-builds the gate's scope.
notes: Verified on disk: src/Prompt.ts:498 and :531-532, and src/Dispatcher.ts:3622-3626, each spell `assignedEntry && phase.scopeWritesToEntry` and `declaredPaths(entry)` with `phase.entryChannelPaths ?? []`; only the final set-union is shared. tests/Prompt.test.ts:416-419 hand-builds the gate's half, so a one-sided change to either production site ships green. EntryWriteScope is module-private in src/builtinGates.ts today.
